name: All foundation systems MUST meet phase 1 mandated security controls by March 31st 2026 to ensure critical protection against common attacks.
requirementTitle: All foundation systems MUST meet phase 1 mandated security controls by March 31st 2026 to ensure critical protection against common attacks.
requirementDescription: The organisation has identified a minimum set of essential security controls. Any critical foundational platform must have those controls in place by 31 March 2026, because those controls provide protection against the most common cyber attacks.
why:
The purpose is to implement the most important security controls first, reducing risks from common threats such as:
- Phishing
- Credential theft
- Unpatched vulnerabilities
- Misconfigured cloud resources
- Excessive privileges
- Ransomware
tasks: All foundation systems MUST meet phase 1 mandated security controls by March 31st 2026 to ensure critical protection against common attacks.
